subject: Vendor setup: VAT evidence, PO fields, and onboarding checklist for EU Supplies
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@eu-supplies.it>, Matteo Bianchi <matteo.bianchi@eu-supplies.it>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup: VAT evidence, PO fields, and onboarding checklist for EU Supplies

Hi Elena / Matteo —

Thanks for agreeing to onboard with Redwood. To get a PO issued and payments flowing, we need a few items from you. I've summarized what Finance needs so we can set you up cleanly in our system and make sure VAT is handled correctly.

Request list (what we need from EU Supplies Srl):
- Signed vendor onboarding form (attached: EU_Supplies_vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf)
- Legal company name + registration number and country (exact formatting for our vendor record)
- EU VAT registration number (official format + a scan of the VAT certificate)
- Bank details for EUR SEPA transfers (beneficiary name, IBAN, SWIFT/BIC)
- Point-of-contact for invoicing and a sample invoice (so we can confirm invoice fields)
- For US tax withholding purposes: if you're a non-US entity please provide a completed W-8BEN-E OR confirm you are not a US person (see note below)

Notes on VAT:
- If you are providing services from an EU country to Redwood (US customer), we typically apply the reverse-charge mechanism (no VAT charged by supplier; Redwood self-accounts for VAT where applicable). However, we need the vendor's VAT certificate on file to justify that treatment and for our VAT reporting.
- If you have local requirements to charge VAT to a US entity, flag that now and we'll review with Tax.

Operational notes for the PO: please include the following on the vendor PO fields so Finance can match invoices automatically:
- PO header: "Reverse charge applies — VAT not charged by supplier" (if reverse charge applies)
- Vendor VAT ID field populated exactly as on the certificate
- Currency: EUR
- Remit-to: the bank details you provide

Next steps:
- Elena/Matteo: please return the signed onboarding form + VAT certificate + bank details by EOD Thursday (2026-05-13) so we can create the vendor record and issue a PO.
- Lauren/Marissa: I'll forward the docs to finance for final tax treatment confirmation once we receive them.

Thanks — let me know if anything is unclear.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0118

Attachment: EU_Supplies_vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf

Thanks, and apologies for the slight delay. Attaching the documents you requested:

A couple of clarifications from our side:
1) We are a services company (Italy). For US customers we normally issue invoices without Italian VAT under the reverse-charge treatment when the customer is liable to self-account for VAT. We will not charge VAT if you confirm reverse charge applies.
2) Currency — we prefer EUR (SEPA). Can Redwood pay in EUR?
3) W-8BEN-E — we are a non-US entity; we can fill the W-8BEN-E if required for your accounts payable to avoid any US withholding. Please let us know if you need the completed form on file before the first payment.

Jonas — thanks for the forward and good catch collecting the VAT cert. Quick summary from Finance / Tax:

1) VAT treatment:
- For services supplied by an EU-based company (EU Supplies, Italy) to a US entity where the place of supply is effectively outside Italy, we will generally apply the reverse-charge (customer self-accounting) approach. That means the supplier should not charge Italian VAT on their invoices to Redwood. They must include their VAT ID on the invoice and a statement such as: "Reverse charge applies — VAT to be self-accounted by the recipient (Art. X)." Keep the vendor VAT cert on file.

2) W-8BEN-E:
- Because Redwood is a US-based payer, please request the vendor completes and returns a W-8BEN-E to avoid any potential US withholding on US-source payments. Store the form in vendor documents.

3) Vendor master fields and PO wording:
- Vendor classification: "Foreign supplier — Reverse charge (EU)"
- QuickBooks vendor ID: QV-9872 (Finance will create upon receiving signed onboarding form + W-8BEN-E)
- PO header: include line: "Reverse charge applies — VAT not charged by supplier. Supplier VAT ID: IT12345678901"
- Currency: EUR; Payment method: SEPA (enter IBAN + BIC)
- Remittance: include the full remit-to details as provided in their bank_details file

4) Documentation required before first payment:
- Signed onboarding form (we have it)
- VAT certificate (we have it)
- Completed W-8BEN-E (ask vendor to return)
- Copy of the invoice matching PO fields

5) PO requirement:
- Yes, issue PO before they invoice. Once vendor is set up in QuickBooks and we issue the PO with the reverse-charge wording, they can invoice and AP will match automatically.

Action items:
- Jonas: confirm with Elena that Redwood will not be charged VAT and request a completed W-8BEN-E. Ask them to add the invoice language above.
- Marissa: I will create the vendor record (QV-9872) once we receive the W-8BEN-E and will issue a PO (for the onboarding project) after vendor creation.

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
